## Download

### ⬇️ [Windows installer (x64)](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/nagare-setup-{{VERSION}}.exe)

The easy way. Installs Nagare for your user alone (no administrator needed), can start it when you sign in, and uninstalls cleanly from Settings > Apps.

### 📦 [Portable zip (x64)](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/nagare-portable-{{VERSION}}.zip)

`nagare.exe` and its watchdog, to unzip anywhere and run. No Start menu entry, and no start at sign-in.

---

- **Needs:** Windows 10 or 11 on a 64-bit Intel or AMD PC, with a GPU that runs Vulkan or OpenGL 3.3. Without one, Nagare falls back to its software renderer.
- **{{SIGNED}}**
- Built with profile-guided optimisation. The SHA-256 checksums of both files are in `SHA256SUMS.txt` below.
- New to Nagare? Poke the desktop 9 times to open the settings, then try playing some music.
